item.btmi.exclamation_mark.tooltip: Hold use to charge, release to smash
item.btmi.exclamation_mark.tooltip2: Hitting a block shatters blocks around it and sends out a shockwave; the longer the charge, the larger the area (capped)
item.btmi.exclamation_mark.tooltip3: Press the %s key: Home Run, launching every enemy in the fan-shaped area ahead
item.btmi.exclamation_mark.lore: Silence is for everyone else. You are here to be heard.
item.btmi.dash.tooltip1: Left click: the staff splits into a blade and its sheath
item.btmi.dash.tooltip2: Right click: fire a light orb, lightning strikes on impact
item.btmi.dash.tooltip3: Sneak + hold attack: charge, then leap forward with a slash
item.btmi.dash.tooltip4: Hits build energy; at 10 stacks press the %s key to unleash Myriad Projection
item.btmi.dash.lore: One stroke splits the long night; every story is written after it.
item.btmi.equal_sign.tooltip1: Left click: a heavy double-bladed cleave, high damage but slow
item.btmi.equal_sign.tooltip2: Press the %s key: Bisect, cleave a fissure across the ground ahead
item.btmi.equal_sign.tooltip3: Held in the off hand with Slash in the main hand, the %s key triggers Strikethrough instead
item.btmi.equal_sign.lore: Only when both sides weigh the same can we talk about fairness.
item.btmi.slash.tooltip1: A long thrusting spear with more reach than a normal one-handed weapon
item.btmi.slash.tooltip2: Press the %s key: Piercing Line, a long thrust ahead
item.btmi.slash.tooltip3: Held in the main hand with Equal Sign in the off hand, the %s key triggers Strikethrough instead
item.btmi.slash.lore: The line you cannot finish is the one it crosses out.
item.btmi.death_sign.tooltip1: Left click: extend the light blade from the cross
item.btmi.death_sign.tooltip2: Sneak + right click: summon a floating sentinel, the weapon turns into Recall Death Sign
item.btmi.death_sign.tooltip3: Main and off hand can both summon one; the two sentinels act independently
item.btmi.death_sign.tooltip4: Press the %s key: ring the death knell, calling down a cross of light and marking the enemies it hits
item.btmi.death_sign.lore: First the bell, then the roll call. Those named need not answer.
item.btmi.death_sign_recall.tooltip1: Left click: the sentinel thrusts forward and rams the target
item.btmi.death_sign_recall.tooltip2: Hold right click: the sentinel keeps firing laser bolts
item.btmi.death_sign_recall.tooltip3: Press the %s key: the sentinel darts forward and detonates, destroying itself
item.btmi.death_sign_recall.tooltip4: Press the %s key: ring the death knell, calling down a cross of light and marking the enemies it hits
item.btmi.death_sign_recall.lore: What returns is not a weapon, but a verdict left unfinished.
item.btmi.colon.tooltip1: Right click: open the six-chamber cylinder, any bullet can be loaded (duplicates allowed)
item.btmi.colon.tooltip2: Left click: fire the bullet in the selected chamber
item.btmi.colon.tooltip3: Hold the %s key: open the bullet selection wheel
item.btmi.colon.tooltip4: Each bullet type behaves differently; see the bullet tooltips
item.btmi.colon.tooltip5: Press the %s key: Fan the Hammer, firing every loaded chamber in quick succession
item.btmi.colon.lore: Six chambers, six statements that allow no reply.
item.btmi.high_explosive_bullet.tooltip: Explodes on impact and can break blocks
item.btmi.incendiary_bullet.tooltip: Ignites the surrounding area and sets targets on fire
item.btmi.paralysis_bullet.tooltip: Leaves the target frozen in place for a few seconds
item.btmi.piercing_bullet.tooltip: Higher damage, passes through a hit target and keeps flying
item.btmi.cryo_bullet.tooltip: Freezes and heavily slows creatures in the area
item.btmi.seeker_bullet.tooltip: Locks onto the nearest target and curves toward it
item.btmi.scarlet_fang.tooltip1: Left click: fire, right click: switch firing mode
item.btmi.scarlet_fang.tooltip2: Press the %s key: spin once to draw an energy ring, which then pulses outward for damage
item.btmi.scarlet_fang.tooltip3: Burst: rapid shots; Laser: instant hitscan beam; Shotgun: short-range lightning fan
item.btmi.scarlet_fang.lore: It does not ask you to turn back. It simply bites the road shut.
item.btmi.flame_cape.tooltip1: A cape woven from flowing flames, worn in the chest slot
item.btmi.flame_cape.tooltip2: Any damage you deal gains extra fire damage and sets the target ablaze
item.btmi.flame_cape.tooltip3: Press the %s key to summon butterflies; press the %s key to send them at the target under your crosshair
item.btmi.flame_cape.lore: What rests on your shoulders is not fire, but a swarm of butterflies that refuses to leave.

An Epic Fight addon.
btmi.configuration.title: BTMI Configs
item.btmi.blood_rain_mortar.tooltip1: Place it, then use it to open the loading hatch
item.btmi.blood_rain_mortar.tooltip2: Load a shell and close the screen; it fires on its own shortly after
item.btmi.blood_rain_mortar.lore: What falls from the sky is rain, and also a verdict.
item.btmi.blood_rain_shell.tooltip2: On impact the sky turns to blood rain for 3 minutes
gui.btmi.blood_rain.hint: Load a shell and close this screen to fire
commands.btmi.bell.status.off: You do not hold Bell Tower authority
commands.btmi.bell.creative: Only creative mode players can gain Bell Tower authority
commands.btmi.bloodrain.started: Blood rain begins falling in this dimension
commands.btmi.bloodrain.stopped: Blood rain has stopped in this dimension
commands.btmi.bloodrain.inactive: There is no blood rain in this dimension
commands.btmi.bell.target_creative: %s is not in creative mode and cannot gain Bell Tower authority
commands.btmi.bell.granted_count: Granted Bell Tower authority to %s player(s)
gui.btmi.skills.title: Bell Tower Skills
gui.btmi.skills.hint: Press %s to cast the active skill, %s closes
skill.btmi.blood_rain.name: Blood Rain
skill.btmi.blood_rain.desc: While blood rain falls, a shield of blood stops projectiles and holds creatures back.
skill.btmi.bell_toll.name: Bell Toll
skill.btmi.bell_toll.desc: Unfolds a giant clock sigil beneath your feet; the falling bell cracks the ground and hurls nearby enemies back.
skill.btmi.blood_rush.name: Blood Rush
skill.btmi.blood_rush.desc: Become a blood shadow and dash forward through open space.
class.btmi.none.desc: No Bell Tower class chosen yet.
class.btmi.harbinger.desc: Reveals the battlefield and calls down Bell Tower strikes through the messenger box.
class.btmi.agent.desc: Shatters formations with devastating bell impacts and knockback.
skill.btmi.agent_ruin.name: City Breaker
skill.btmi.agent_ruin.desc: Slams down a ruinous bell toll, crushing and launching nearby enemies.
item.btmi.storyteller_book.desc: Right-click to read the tasks left by the Bell Tower.
item.btmi.messenger_box.desc: Harbinger only. Place it, then right-click to call down a Bell Tower strike.
gui.btmi.skills.find_book: Locked: find and read the Storyteller Book first
gui.btmi.book.title: Storyteller Book
gui.btmi.book.line.bell: Ring the bell at the tower top: %s/%s
gui.btmi.book.line.hits: Hit enemies with Bell Tower skills: %s/%s
gui.btmi.book.done: The Bell Tower has recognized you
gui.btmi.book.hint: Clues wait inside the Bell Tower in the overworld
gui.btmi.book.recognized.line1: You have formally gained Bell Tower authority
gui.btmi.book.recognized.line2: Press Right Alt to open the skill menu and choose your class
gui.btmi.revelation.title: Revelation
message.btmi.messenger_box.class: Only a Harbinger can use the Messenger Box
item.btmi.chairman_file.desc: Old documents scattered across the world, seemingly recording the past of the Republic of Incarnadine.
gui.btmi.book.file.hint: Search chests across the world for three aged documents
message.btmi.messenger_box.active: The Bell Tower strike is already underway
message.btmi.messenger_box.cooldown: The Messenger Box is still recharging
skill.btmi.harbinger_revelation.name: Revelation
skill.btmi.harbinger_revelation.desc: Senses nearby life, marking and reporting hostile targets.
item.btmi.digamma.desc: Durability is Bell Tower energy. It must be in your inventory or hotbar, and it never breaks when depleted.
message.btmi.energy.no_item: Carry Digamma in your inventory or hotbar
gui.btmi.tower_core.hint: Insert Digamma: restores 1 energy every 10 ticks
gui.btmi.chronicle.title: Chronicle of State Affairs
gui.btmi.chronicle.p1.a: 14:00 - Received the Star Domain Governor report on the depletion of the Long Night Star Domain. The governor says its lights are going out one by one, and the last three extraction stations can last only forty more cycles.
gui.btmi.chronicle.p1.b: 15:30 - Reviewed the Ministry of Transmission annual roster of heroic narratives. Seven new names were added, and the Ministry proposed turning them into new constellations. I crossed out two of them, for they are not dead yet.
gui.btmi.chronicle.p2.a: 09:10 - The Commander reports that the Lost Empire vanguard has entered the Anchor.
gui.btmi.chronicle.p2.b: 09:12 - I confirm: authorization granted to restart the Calamity Sequence. Let later generations remember only what we held.
gui.btmi.chronicle.p3.a: 03:47 - I have received a bottom-level alarm from the Bell Tower. A set of parallel-timeline signals that should not exist is attempting to merge with the main universe.
gui.btmi.chronicle.p3.b: 03:49 - This is impossible... this is... a world made of blocks?
